note: Keyed class|platform|zygosity. Classes: plp vus conflicting benign drug_response risk_factor other. Platforms: wgs_wes array. Templates take {stars} and {platform_words}.

plp|wgs_wes|any.how_sure: ClinVar rates the classification {stars} of 4 review stars. The call came from {platform_words}, which reads this kind of change reliably.
plp|wgs_wes|any.next_step: Confirm the result with a clinical laboratory test before you act on it. Ask a doctor about a referral to genetic counselling.

plp|array|any.how_sure: ClinVar rates the classification {stars} of 4 review stars. The call came from a consumer genotyping array. Arrays misread rare changes often, so this call is provisional.
plp|array|any.next_step: Do not act on this result alone. Ask a doctor for a clinical test that reads the change directly.

vus|any|any.how_sure: Laboratories have not settled what this change does. ClinVar records it as uncertain.
vus|any|any.next_step: No action follows from an uncertain change. Laboratories reclassify these over time, so a clinician can check again later.

conflicting|any|any.how_sure: Laboratories disagree about this change. ClinVar records the disagreement rather than a verdict.
conflicting|any|any.next_step: No action follows from a contested change. A genetic counsellor can explain what the disagreement is about.

benign|any|any.how_sure: ClinVar rates the classification {stars} of 4 review stars.
benign|any|any.next_step: This classification says the change does not cause the named condition. It says nothing about other causes of that condition.

drug_response|any|any.how_sure: ClinVar records a drug-response effect for this change, with {stars} of 4 review stars.
drug_response|any|any.next_step: Tell a prescriber about this result before you start a medicine it affects. A pharmacist can check the current guidance.

risk_factor|any|any.how_sure: ClinVar records this change as a risk factor, with {stars} of 4 review stars. A risk factor shifts odds. It does not decide an outcome.
risk_factor|any|any.next_step: Discuss this with a doctor if the condition runs in your family.

other|any|any.how_sure: ClinVar records an association without a classification.
